findings.problem: Bare "welcome" can also be the noun ("a warm welcome"), so "la bienvenida" would also be a right answer.
findings.fix: hint: greeting a guest, as in 'Welcome!' (adjective, not the noun)

findings.problem: The example sentence has no conjugated verb.
findings.fix: example.es: Siempre eres bienvenido aquí. / example.en: You're always welcome here.

back.es: welcome (adjective/interjection: welcome, said to someone arriving)

note: The trick's breakdown into bien + venido (participle of venir) is accurate.
